prompts.main: Use case: logo-brand. Reference images 1 and 2 are character/style reference boards, not output layouts. Create exactly ONE isolated square production application icon for WPS Assistant, matching the large main icon shown on the boards closely: cute soft 3D orange teddy bear with round ears, glossy black eyes, one eye winking, cream muzzle, pink cheeks, royal blue scarf, holding white spreadsheet document with green grid on viewer left and white presentation document with orange abstract slide glyph on viewer right. Yellow-to-orange rounded square tile behind bear. Centered straight-on, charming polished clay render. Tile fills 94% of square canvas, symmetric transparent outer margin, rounded corners genuinely transparent. Keep the whole bear and papers inside tile, no external shadow beyond tile. No text, no watermarks, no labels, no multiple samples, no mockup. High resolution square icon.
prompts.small: Use case: logo-brand. Input image is a character/style reference board. Extract/recreate ONLY the simplified small-size icon concept from section 2, as ONE standalone square production icon. Cute orange teddy bear head, both glossy black eyes open, round ears, cream muzzle and tiny happy smile, soft pink cheeks, bright royal blue scarf visible underneath. Warm yellow to orange rounded-square tile fills 94% of canvas with transparent margin and transparent corners. Friendly polished 3D clay style exactly matching the reference character. Face fills tile prominently, symmetrical centered front view. Designed to remain recognizable at 16 and 24 pixels: clean large facial features, no hands, no documents, no symbols, no text, no watermark, no board, no multiple versions. Square high resolution.
prompts.template: Use case: logo-brand. Input image is a style/character reference board. Create exactly ONE minimal monochrome menu-bar template icon based on the outline bear in section 3 of the reference. Front-facing round teddy bear head with two round ears, two solid dot eyes, tiny nose and smiling muzzle, scarf suggested by one simple curved shape under chin. Pure solid BLACK strokes/shapes only, all other pixels genuinely transparent including face interior. No white fills, no gray shading, no gradient, no background tile, no shadow, no text, no watermark. Bold smooth clean strokes optimized for macOS 22px menu bar at 1x and 2x: closed outer silhouette and very few interior details, consistent stroke weight, no fur. Centered composition with symmetric 8% margin in a square canvas. This is an isolated icon, not a board.
prompts.variables: Use case: logo-brand. Images are style and character references. Create ONE production WPS Ribbon variable-management icon matching this orange teddy bear with royal blue scarf. A simple prominent front-facing bear head with open glossy black eyes, cream muzzle and smile, and one large green rounded spreadsheet/table badge at bottom right, with a clear white 2x2 cell grid. Bear head takes most of frame, badge takes approximately 35% of frame. Soft clean 3D clay render with large simplified features, suitable at 32px. Genuinely transparent background, NO background tile, no full body, no papers, no text, no watermark, no extra symbols, no tiny decorative details. Centered square icon with safe 6% margins; bear and badge must not be clipped. Only one isolated icon.
prompts.status: Use case: logo-brand. Images are character/style references. Create ONE production WPS Ribbon connection-status icon matching this orange teddy bear with royal blue scarf. One large royal blue circular badge at bottom right containing TWO interlocking thick WHITE chain links representing connection, very simple and clearly recognizable at 32px. Head takes most of frame, badge about 35% of square. Soft clean 3D clay render, large simplified features.
